face.title: Natural face care
face.metaTitle: Natural face care – creams, serums and masks
face.metaDescription: Natural saffron face creams, vitamin C serums, masks, micellar water and sunscreen from Bulgarian brands. Order online with delivery across Bulgaria.
face.lead: Creams, serums, masks and cleansers for the face from Bulgarian brands.
body: This category brings together natural face care from three Bulgarian brands: Saffron Adela Sunny (with saffron grown in Bulgaria), Voditsa (with tuberose extract and floral waters) and Shafpol Beauty (with saffron, pearl and vitamin C).

There are products for every step of your routine: cleansing (micellar water, cleansing gel), hydration (face mist, saffron water), nourishing and anti-ageing care (day, night and eye cream, serum) and sun protection (SPF 50+ face cream).

faq.question: Which saffron face cream should I choose?
faq.answer: The Saffron Adela Sunny face cream (50 ml) combines hyaluronic acid, 100% natural ISO 3632 saffron, peach oil, Brazil nut oil, aloe vera and vitamin E. It is suitable for the face, neck and décolleté.

faq.question: What is the difference between the Voditsa day and night creams?
faq.answer: The Voditsa day cream has a light texture, absorbs quickly and works well under make-up. The night cream is richer and is made to restore the skin's moisture and elasticity overnight. Both contain tuberose extract.

faq.question: Do you deliver across Bulgaria?
faq.answer: Yes. We deliver with Speedy to an office, a parcel locker or an address anywhere in Bulgaria, usually within 1–3 working days.

hair.title: Natural hair care
hair.metaTitle: Natural saffron shampoo and hair conditioner
hair.metaDescription: Natural saffron shampoo, hair conditioner and 2-in-1 wash by Saffron Adela Sunny – made in Bulgaria with Bulgarian saffron. Order online.
hair.lead: Shampoos, conditioner and 2-in-1 products with saffron, created and made in Bulgaria.
body: Saffron Adela Sunny hair care is the first Bulgarian line of wash products with saffron (Crocus sativus). The saffron is grown in Bulgaria.

The saffron shampoo is the brand's bestselling product and suits every hair type. The saffron conditioner contains olive oil, argan oil, jojoba oil, vitamin E and D-panthenol. For travel there is a 50 ml shampoo and a travel set.

faq.question: Which natural saffron shampoos do you sell?
faq.answer: The Saffron Adela Sunny saffron shampoo comes in 250 ml and 50 ml (travel) sizes. For men there is also a saffron hair and body wash (300 ml and 50 ml).

faq.question: Which hair type is the saffron shampoo for?
faq.answer: The saffron shampoo suits every hair type and everyday use. For dry and damaged hair you can pair it with the saffron hair conditioner.

faq.question: Where are the saffron cosmetics made?
faq.answer: The Saffron Adela Sunny line is created and made in Bulgaria by Brami Trade, with saffron grown in Bulgaria.

body.title: Natural body care
body.metaTitle: Natural saffron shower gel, body lotion and soap
body.metaDescription: Natural shower gels, body cream-lotion and handmade glycerin soap with saffron from Bulgaria. Gift sets and travel sizes.
body.lead: Shower gels, lotion and soap with saffron, gift sets and travel sizes.
body: Saffron Adela Sunny body care is made with saffron grown in Bulgaria. There are saffron shower gels for every skin type, a hair and body wash for men, a body cream-lotion with 10 nourishing ingredients and a handmade glycerin soap with saffron.
As a gift there is the “Saffron Adela Sunny” set (shampoo, shower gel and soap), and for travel a set of three 50 ml products.

faq.question: What is in the saffron body cream-lotion?
faq.answer: The cream-lotion (120 ml) contains shea butter, cocoa butter, jojoba oil, coconut oil, aloe vera oil extract, glycerin, beeswax and 100% natural ISO 3632 saffron.

faq.question: Is there a saffron gift set?
faq.answer: Yes. The “Saffron Adela Sunny” set contains a 250 ml saffron shampoo, a 250 ml saffron shower gel and an 80 g saffron glycerin soap.

faq.question: Do you have travel-size cosmetics for flights?
faq.answer: Yes. The saffron shampoo, shower gel and men's wash also come in 50 ml, and the travel set contains three 50 ml products.

saffron.title: Saffron cosmetics
saffron.metaDescription: Natural cosmetics with Bulgarian saffron: shampoo, conditioner, creams, shower gels, soap, saffron water and serum. Created in Bulgaria by Brami. Order online.
saffron.lead: Shampoos, creams, shower gels and face care with saffron grown in Bulgaria.
body: Saffron (Crocus sativus) is a flower whose stigmas give one of the most valuable spices in the world. In cosmetics it is valued for its antioxidant properties.

Brami grows saffron in Bulgaria. After research carried out in 2019–2021, the team created Saffron Adela Sunny – the first line of hair and body wash products with saffron created and made in Bulgaria. The products use 100% natural saffron that meets the ISO 3632 standard.

Here you will find every saffron product in the shop – from the shampoo and hair conditioner to the face cream, body cream-lotion, soap, saffron hydrosol and the serum with saffron, pearl and vitamin C.

faq.question: What are Brami's best-known saffron products?
faq.answer: The bestselling product is the saffron shampoo. The Saffron Adela Sunny line also includes a hair conditioner, a face cream, a body cream-lotion, shower gels and a glycerin soap with saffron.

faq.question: Is the saffron in the cosmetics Bulgarian?
faq.answer: Yes. Brami grows saffron in Bulgaria and uses it in the Saffron Adela Sunny line.

faq.question: What is ISO 3632?
faq.answer: ISO 3632 is the international standard that defines saffron quality – colour, aroma and flavour. The saffron in Saffron Adela Sunny products is 100% natural and meets this standard.

bulgarian.title: Bulgarian natural cosmetics
bulgarian.metaTitle: Bulgarian natural cosmetics – Saffron Adela Sunny, Voditsa, Shafpol
bulgarian.metaDescription: Natural cosmetics from Bulgarian brands: Saffron Adela Sunny with Bulgarian saffron, Voditsa and Shafpol Beauty. Face, body and hair care delivered across Bulgaria.
bulgarian.lead: Natural face, body and hair care from Bulgarian brands.
body: At Brami we select cosmetics from Bulgarian producers. Saffron Adela Sunny is our own line made with saffron grown in Bulgaria – shampoos, conditioner, creams, shower gels and soap.

Voditsa offers face care with tuberose extract, floral waters and cold-pressed oils – anti-wrinkle creams, a mask, a mist and micellar water. Shafpol Beauty offers a serum with saffron, pearl and vitamin C, an SPF 50+ sunscreen and a face cleansing gel.
All products are delivered by Speedy across Bulgaria, usually within 1–3 working days, and delivery is free for orders over €70.

faq.question: Which Bulgarian natural cosmetics brands do you sell?
faq.answer: Saffron Adela Sunny (Brami's own line with Bulgarian saffron), Voditsa and Shafpol Beauty.

faq.question: Is there free delivery?
faq.answer: Yes, delivery is free for orders over €70.

faq.question: How can I order?
faq.answer: Order online at brami.shop. You can choose delivery to a Speedy office, a parcel locker or an address.
